attempts.text:
{
  "map": true,
  "subject": {
    "columns": ["did", "mondoid"],
    "resolver": "curie",
    "category": "biolink:Disease"
  },
  "object": {
    "columns": ["protein_id"],
    "resolver": "pharos_protein",
    "category": "biolink:Protein"
  },
  "predicate": "biolink:associated_with",
  "association_category": "biolink:Association",
  "knowledge_level": "observation",
  "agent_type": "text_mining_agent",
  "primary_knowledge_source": "infores:jensenlab-diseases",
  "qualifiers": {},
  "edge_properties": ["conf", "evidence"],
  "keep_if": null,
  "split_by": null,
  "notes": "Maps diseases to associated proteins. Uses DOID or MONDO IDs for diseases and Pharos protein IDs (resolved to UniProtKB) for objects. Conf and evidence scores are preserved as edge properties. JensenLab DISEASES aggregates text mining, experimental, and curated data."
}
